question: Which existing JANUS mechanisms can be translated into exact TRUMP interface handling, especially when canonical feedback interface width exceeds log L?

inspected_mechanisms.mechanism: canonical request binding + immutable settled receipt + hash-checked replay
inspected_mechanisms.translation: Use a canonical boundary-message identity and replay only an independently verified exact message for that identity.
inspected_mechanisms.does_not_prove: Fewer semantic boundary states or polynomial-size exact relation representation.

inspected_mechanisms.mechanism: post-lock reread; duplicate converges to canonical settled receipt; unresolved state fails closed
inspected_mechanisms.translation: Exact semantic-message memoization must re-read canonical state before reuse and must not infer success from duplicate/reuse alone.
inspected_mechanisms.does_not_prove: A quotient between semantically different interface relations.

inspected_mechanisms.mechanism: different semantic mutation kinds receive different typed request/receipt contracts
inspected_mechanisms.translation: Do not force 2CNF, Horn, Dual-Horn and mixed boundary relations into one generic table language. Define typed exact boundary receipts with type-specific construction, normalization, composition and verification rules.
inspected_mechanisms.required_TRUMP_proof: For each type, exact equivalence to the projected boundary relation plus polynomial representation/construction/update/reconstruction/verification.

inspected_mechanisms.mechanism: completion-first canonical proofpack hashing and independent integrity verification
inspected_mechanisms.translation: A boundary receipt should be sealed only after all semantic fields and reconstruction data are complete; hash is integrity metadata, not semantic proof.
Namespace message hashes by exact relation language/schema so equal digests never silently equate different semantics.
inspected_mechanisms.does_not_prove: Semantic equivalence from hash equality unless canonical semantic bytes are independently defined and checked.

inspected_mechanisms.mechanism: freeze-first canonical bytes, multiplicity accounting, causal DAG, fail-closed verifier
inspected_mechanisms.translation: Freeze exact boundary-message bytes and account for every distinct candidate message; missing evidence is OPEN, never zero/false by default.
inspected_mechanisms.rejected_translation: AIFC d-separation is a probabilistic causal criterion and cannot be substituted for SAT separator semantics without a new exact proof.

inspected_mechanisms.mechanism: OPEN -> exact quota -> HOLD -> DRAIN -> clean valley -> REOPEN while preserving SHA-256 verification semantics
inspected_mechanisms.translation: Can bound active work queues or stage exact message construction without changing semantics.
inspected_mechanisms.does_not_prove: That omitted interface states are unnecessary; quota/flow control cannot prune exact semantic states.

inspected_mechanisms.mechanism: entropy/progress scores, random recombination and zlib compression score
inspected_mechanisms.reason: random.sample/random.choice, weighted scoring and byte compressibility do not preserve exact SAT boundary relations.

inspected_mechanisms.mechanism: preserve failed attempts/constraints/lineage; model output is not independent confirmation
inspected_mechanisms.translation: Preserve failed compression candidates and counterexamples as immutable lineage; never promote repeated model output into proof.

derived_TRUMP_architecture.name: TYPED_CANONICAL_BOUNDARY_RECEIPT
components: exact replay/dedup only after verifier acceptance
derived_TRUMP_architecture.critical_firewall: Receipt/dedup architecture can prevent duplicate work, but it is polynomially useful against |B|>log L only if the number/size of distinct exact semantic receipts is itself polynomially bounded by theorem.

highest_value_algebraic_translation_targ.name: EXACT_2CNF_BOUNDARY_PROJECTION_IMPLICATION_CLOSURE
highest_value_algebraic_translation_targ.origin: TRUMP derivation suggested by the typed-receipt harvest; not claimed as code already implemented in the inspected repositories
highest_value_algebraic_translation_targ.idea: For a 2CNF module, existential projection to boundary variables remains a bijunctive relation. Represent the projected relation by canonical implication reachability among boundary literals rather than a 2^k truth table.
required_proof_obligations: canonical implication closure over boundary literals is polynomial-size (O(k^2) candidate bound)
closure can be constructed in polynomial time from the module implication graph
SAT witness reconstruction from the projected receipt is polynomial

horn_dual_horn_warning.note: Existential projection stays within the semantic Horn/Dual-Horn relational classes, but an explicit clause basis can be exponentially large. Do not assume the 2CNF O(k^2) implication-closure argument transfers.

mixed_interface_warning.note: Unrestricted mixed typed interaction is already known in TRUMP to encounter a 3SAT identity-image completeness barrier. Generic typed receipts cannot be claimed polynomial without a new restriction/invariant.
